idea-plugin.name: Maven Consistency Enforcer
idea-plugin.description:
Stop fighting ghosts in your classpath!
Maven Consistency Enforcer (MCE) solves the frustrating problem of stale JAR artifacts preventing your code changes from reaching the running application in IntelliJ IDEA.
What it does: - Automatically detects stale JAR artifacts from ~/.m2/repository - Replaces them with direct module-to-module dependencies after Maven reloads - Manual purge action to clean target/build directories
MCE ensures that what you see in your editor matches exactly what runs in your JVM.

action.description: Delete target/build directories and enforce module consistency
